what_it_does: MEGA.mini is a specialized AI processor (called an NPU—Neural Processing Unit, a chip designed specifically to run AI models) that solves a common problem: most numbers in AI math are small and can be compressed to use fewer bits, but some numbers are outliers and must stay precise. Rather than picking one size-fits-all approach, MEGA.mini uses two compute areas: a large, fast section that handles compressed fixed-point numbers (rounded to 16 or 8 bits), and a smaller, precise section that handles high-precision floating-point numbers for the difficult cases. The chip automatically switches between them based on what the data needs.
